headline: Tribunal británico confirma orden del Gobierno que exige el acceso a los datos de Apple
summary: A London tribunal confirmed a British government order requiring Apple to bypass encryption and provide access to customer data held by the company. The ruling was reported on Thursday.
why: Apple is a US technology company whose encryption and privacy policies shape its global products and regulatory exposure. Government data-access orders can affect its UK operations and reputation.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: A UK order to access encrypted customer data directly targets Apple's data-security practices.
